decisions.reason: As a close-to-core custom hearing product, it benefits from prior development effort and a growing market, so management is likely to continue supporting it despite limited public visibility.
The firm has visibly committed to this branded earmold on its own webpage and its strong fit with the established hearing business makes withdrawal unlikely.
